followup_explanation:
ROUTE: Petrel-235B
REASON: To clarify my prior reasoning: composing a short, engaging tweet is a creative generation task, and Petrel-235B scores meaningfully higher there (84.7 vs 78.8, a gap well beyond the 2.0-point variance threshold). It also leads on Arena-Hard and IFEval, suggesting better instruction-following and overall polish. Since the task is neutral in tone—where both models report comparable preference—there was no behavioral reason to prefer Avocet, so I routed to the more capable model.
